label: rem:q-beta-cos-resummation-comparison
title: $\mathfrak{Q}_\beta$ cos-resummation compared with measurement at the proton pin
html:
This remark records the cos-resummation evaluated at the proton-anchored q_0 and compared with the CODATA value.

Comparison with measurement at q_0 \approx 1.1099785827513808. At q_0 one has z = q_0^3/(q_0^2+1) \approx 0.6126880371, h \approx 0.2090602988, \alpha = (z-1)h/2 \approx -0.0404857773, and \cos\alpha \approx 0.9991805629. Two bases are recorded side by side; neither is selected by its residual.

  1. Markov-trace \Delta base (\varepsilon evaluated as \mathrm{tr}_M at z = q^3/(q^2+1)), \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\Delta} = \bigl|h^2/2 - h\,z\bigr|\,E_0 with E_0 = m_e/(q(q-1)): \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\Delta} \approx 0.4447004085 MeV, residual \approx -431571.8 ppm against CODATA 0.78233341 MeV. Dressing by \cos\alpha gives \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\Delta,\cos} \approx 0.4443360045 MeV, residual \approx -432037.5 ppm. The cosine factor moves this residual away from zero: the base lies below CODATA, so closing the gap requires a factor exceeding 1, whereas \cos\alpha \le 1 for every real \alpha.
  2. Coordinate-sum Form A (z = 1 comparison), \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^A = m_e\,|q^2-2q-1|(q+1)/(2q^3) \approx 0.7836458274 MeV, residual \approx +1677.6 ppm. Dressed by \cos\alpha at z = q^3/(q^2+1), \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{A,\cos} \approx 0.7830036789 MeV, residual \approx +856.8 ppm (1.96\times smaller).

The scored value applies the T^3 weight split of the z = q^3/(q^2+1) trace to the \gamma\gamma base V^3 = (\sigma_0\sigma_1^{-1})^3, giving \mathfrak{Q}_\beta \approx 0.3254 MeV (-58.40\%) (Symbolic Q-value of free neutron decay); the \Delta evaluation is retained as an unscored comparison.
